basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old mechanical engineer based in Seattle, Washington. I have a keen interest in robotics and competitive gaming, which naturally led me to the Walking War Robots community. I work at a tech startup specializing in drone technology, juggling my time between my job and my passion for robot games. Outside of work and gaming, I love attending local music festivals and exploring new hiking trails. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to travel and explore new interests. I'm usually online in the evenings and during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Washington. My expertise in robotics comes from both my formal education and hands-on experience at my job. I'm also a self-taught gamer, having played a variety of strategy and action games since my teenage years.
